subject: Personnel screening roster + exit procedures — SOC 2 evidence request
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@kestrel-advisory.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: SOC2 Team <soc2@kestrel-advisory.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: personnel screening + training evidence for SOC 2 SOC2-PSC engagement

Evelyn —

Thanks for taking this engagement. As part of the SOC 2 fieldwork for Redwood Inference (SOC2-PSC), our team needs a consolidated package showing how personnel screening and training controls are applied. Specifically we need the following artifacts: 

- A current roster export (employee id, hire date, role, office/region) with a marker for completed background checks
- Redacted background-check summary (date performed, vendor, clearance result) for hires since 2024-01-01
- Proof of security awareness training completion (roster or LMS export with timestamps) for the last 12 months
- Description or evidence of onboarding and offboarding steps (control matrix, exit checklist, key revocation logs)

If possible please bundle as PDF/CSV and provide a secure link or attachments. We prefer delivery by EOD 18 May to keep the fieldwork schedule on track. If anything above is not available or needs additional redaction steps, let me know and we can scope a narrow exception.

Best,
Alicia Gomez
Senior Auditor, Kestrel Advisory
agomez@kestrel-advisory.com
+1 (415) 555-0184
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@kestrel-advisory.com>
Cc: SOC2 Team <soc2@kestrel-advisory.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: personnel screening + training evidence for SOC 2 SOC2-PSC engagement

Alicia —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts; I will coordinate with HR and Security to produce redacted background summaries and the LMS export. Two quick clarifications before we package: 

1) For the background summary redaction — do you need candidate-level IDs retained (we normally hash employee IDs)?
2) For the exit key revocation logs: do you want a time-range (last 24 months) or all historical revocation events?

Karthik — looping you in for procurement of the secure transfer (we can provide a signed DocuSign receipt if Kestrel requires chain-of-custody). Monica (HR) is on the thread and will assemble the roster and background summaries.

We will aim to deliver a secure bundle by EOD 18 May; if any item cannot be provided we will flag it early.

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:31:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: personnel screening + training evidence for SOC 2 SOC2-PSC engagement

Monica —

Forwarding Kestrel's list. Can you assemble the following items and upload to the secure drive link below: 

- Current personnel roster export (CSV) with fields: employee_id (hashed), name, role, region, hire_date, background_check_status, background_check_date, background_vendor
- LMS export (CSV) for last 12 months with training_id, employee_id (hashed), completion_timestamp
- Redacted background summary PDF (one page per employee: hashed id, date, vendor, result) — redact PII (SSNs, DOBs)
- Onboarding/offboarding control matrix (xlsx) and the standard exit checklist PDF used by IT
- Key revocation events for last 24 months (log export)

Please mark items that require legal review for redaction and include an index file that lists which rows/records were redacted and why. Karthik — can you confirm secure transfer options (DocuSign + encrypted drive or direct SFTP)? I want to avoid sending raw PII over email.

Target: assemble by COB Wed 18 May. If you need a narrower scope to meet the deadline, propose it here.

Thanks —
Evelyn
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Legal Redaction <legal.redaction@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: personnel screening + training evidence for SOC 2 SOC2-PSC engagement

Evelyn / Karthik —

Confirmed. HR has generated the exports and Legal has approved the redaction approach. Attached to this email are stubs and a short index; full files are uploaded to the secure drive (link below). Redaction notes are included in the index CSV. Summary of what was prepared: 

- training_roster_2027-05.csv (LMS export with hashed IDs) [Attachment: training_roster_2027-05.csv]
- background_summary_redacted_2027.pdf (one-page summaries, PII redacted) [Attachment: background_summary_redacted_2027.pdf]
- onboard_offboard_control_matrix_2027.xlsx (control mapping for onboarding and offboarding steps) [Attachment: onboard_offboard_control_matrix_2027.xlsx]
- exit_checklist_template.pdf (standard IT/Facilities exit checklist) [Attachment: exit_checklist_template.pdf]
- index_redaction_log_2027.csv (list of redactions and rationale) [Attachment: index_redaction_log_2027.csv]

Drive link (secure): https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure/packaging/psc-8341
Transfer method: 128-bit AES encrypted package; access by invitation only. DocuSign receipt and chain-of-custody artifacts are attached to the drive as well.

If Kestrel needs additional event-level logs (e.g., raw key revocation event stream), Legal requests a signed data handling addendum — we can provide the stream after that execution.

Regards,
Monica Patel
HR Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Subject: Delivery: personnel screening + training evidence (secure link) — SOC2-PSC

Alicia —

Per your request, we uploaded the requested artifacts to a secure, access-controlled location. Summary: 

- training_roster_2027-05.csv (LMS completions for last 12 months)
- background_summary_redacted_2027.pdf (redacted vendor summaries)
- onboard_offboard_control_matrix_2027.xlsx (control matrix mapping owners to steps)
- exit_checklist_template.pdf (standard exit checklist)
- index_redaction_log_2027.csv (redaction index)

Secure link (expires in 7 days): https://drive.redwood.com/s/secure/packaging/psc-8341
Access notes: link is invitation-only; I have invited Alicia Gomez and the SOC2 team email address. 

Two items to flag: 
1) The raw key revocation event log contains sensitive operational identifiers. Legal requires a signed data handling addendum before we can provide that stream. If you need it for evidence, please send the addendum and we will expedite.
2) Employee IDs are hashed in the exports; if you need mapping for sampling, we can provide a separate mapping under an agreed-to non-disclosure and limited access.

Let me know when you've downloaded the package or if you need any clarifications. Thanks for working with us on timing.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Success Operations
